leads.title: Cameroon Penal Code - Article 347bis (now 347-1), September 1972 Ordinance
leads.documents: Criminalization of consensual male and female same-sex sexual activity; legal basis for prosecution. Article notes 1965 Penal Code did not criminalise.
leads.detail: Cited as 'ordinance issued in September 1972 by President Ahmadou Ahidjo introduced Article 347bis (now 347-1)'; enacted after advent of unitary state when National Assembly had not yet been elected; no URL visible

leads.title: Law on Cybersecurity and Cybercrime, Law No. 2010/012 of 21 December 2010
leads.documents: Criminalises online same-sex sexual propositions and follow-on intercourse; penalties of imprisonment and fines.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Law No. 2010/012 of 21 December 2010' Article 83(1): 1 to 2 years imprisonment and 500,000 to 1,000,000 CFA francs; Article 83(2): penalties doubled when proposals followed by sexual intercourse; no URL visible

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2010 Human Rights Report
leads.documents: Documents societal stigma, discrimination, harassment, imprisonment risk, harassment/extortion by law enforcement, false allegations of homosexuality used to harass/extort; that LGBT people generally kept low profile.
leads.detail: Cited as "US Department of State's 2010 Human Rights Report"; no URL visible
